newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Brazil telecoms' estimates adjusted.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Brazil telecoms' estimates adjusted.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers/Banco Patrimonio said in a report it was adjusting its 1996 earnings estimates for Brazilian telecom firms Telemig, Telepar and Telesp.
-- It slightly reduced Telemig's 1996 earnings estimate to $217.6 million from $232.5 million while it raised its 1996 profit estimate for Telepar to $150.6 million from $136.2 million, it said.
-- Telesp's 1996 earnings estimate was raised to $816.7 million from $752.8 million and Telerj's 1996 profit estimate was maintained at $85.3 million, it added.
-- "Our changes are based on November's results as well as recent conversations with management and are mainly related to tax reversions or provisions for voluntary retirement programs," it said.
-- It said it expected Brazilian local operators to report 1996 results as of the second half of the month.
-- In addition, it said it was maintaining a buy rating for Telesp preferred shares, Telemig preferred B shares and Telepar preferred stock.
-- Salomon Brothers/Banco Patrimonio said it also has maintained a hold rating for Telesp and Telemig common stock and for Telerj preferred shares.
